title: Taygete at SemEval-2022 Task 4: RoBERTa based models for detecting Patronising and Condescending Language
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development and evaluation of RoBERTa-based models for detecting patronizing and condescending language (PCL). While the motivation addresses social harms and discriminatory behavior toward vulnerable groups, the paper does not benchmark or evaluate religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
